## Pre-review checklist

- [ ] Branch targets `develop` (unless a `hotfix/*` or release) and uses `feature/<name>` or `bugfix/<name>` naming.
- [ ] Commits are small, atomic, and follow Conventional Commits (`<type>(<scope>): <subject>`).
- [ ] I reviewed my own diff and confirmed no debug logs or generated files (`node_modules/`, `dist/`, `.DS_Store`) are included.
- [ ] Local quality checks (`npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build`) pass without errors.
